cues: Direction: through the cold junction, the current flows from the metal that comes earlier in the series to the one that comes later.
Through the hot junction it goes the other way.
And size: the further apart the two metals are in the list, the bigger the e m f. Antimony and bismuth sit at the two ends, so an antimony bismuth couple gives the biggest e m f of all.
